story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Event management page created with list/grid view of company events 2. Event creation form with required fields (Name, Start DateTime, Event Type) 3. Event edit form allowing updates to all event metadata 4. Event detail view showing complete event information 5. Event deletion with soft delete confirmation 6. Event status management (Draft, Published, Completed, Cancelled) 7. Event date/time validation (UTC storage, timezone display) 8. Location information management (venue, address, city, coordinates) 9. Event type selection from reference data (Trade Show, Conference, Expo, etc.) 10. Industry classification for events 11. Multi-tenant filtering (users only see their company's events) 12. Search and filter functionality for event list 13. Form validation with clear error messages 14. Success notifications for CRUD operations 15. Comprehensive UAT tests validate all event management workflows

story-context.constraints: - Maintain Epic 1 performance characteristics (event list < 2s) - Preserve all existing Epic 1 functionality without breaking changes - Multi-tenant filtering mandatory (users only see their company's events) - Database schema already exists (verify, don't create) - Reference data tables exist (EventType, EventStatus, Industry, Country) - UTC date/time storage with timezone display support - Soft delete for audit trail compliance - Full audit trail on all CRUD operations - Form validation for all required fields - Success notifications for all operations - Comprehensive UAT testing required - Performance: Event creation < 1s, updates < 1s, deletion < 500ms - Logging: Use enhanced_diagnostic_logs.py to validate all event actions are logged correctly
